solutionSql:
SELECT s.id, s.shipment_id
FROM staging_scans AS s
WHERE s.shipment_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments AS sh WHERE sh.id = s.shipment_id)
ORDER BY s.id;

rules.howSolved: NOT EXISTS against shipments lists each scan whose shipment_id has no matching shipment.
Scans with a matching shipment are excluded by the NOT EXISTS; a NULL shipment_id is excluded explicitly because it names no shipment.

ambiguities: A NULL shipment_id is read as naming no shipment, so it is not listed. The instruction does not say.
Duplicate scan ids would each be listed, one row per copy. The text does not address duplicates.
notes: On sample the five listed scans are the orphan shipments 9000, 9009, 9018, 9027 and 9036. Ordering is by id only, as the instruction asks.
